task.description: Design the ADP-04 test specification and concrete test cases to verify tenant-bound user behavior, default-tenant compatibility for pre-existing users, and cross-tenant isolation in identity/group flows. Produce or update tests/specs/ADP-04.md and any required test source additions or updates under tests/ that align with backend implementation artifacts from step-02. Ensure cases clearly map to ADP-04 acceptance criteria and are ready for TEST-RUNNER execution.
acceptance_criteria: Test spec explicitly maps ADP-04 acceptance criteria to executable test cases
Coverage includes default-tenant backfill compatibility for existing users
Coverage includes positive and negative tenant-isolation identity/group scenarios
Produced test artifacts are runnable by TEST-RUNNER without ambiguity

result.summary: Designed and implemented ADP-04 test coverage by adding a dedicated spec and extending integration tests for tenant-bound user behavior, legacy default-tenant compatibility, and cross-tenant isolation in identity/group membership and claim flows.
